components.name: Portal frame
components.description: Decorative connected planes with a chamfered silhouette, blue glass strokes, and a square lime node.
components.css: .ds-portal{position:relative;width:240px;height:170px;perspective:900px}.ds-portal-frame{position:absolute;inset:20px 40px;border:1px solid #7d97ff;border-radius:40px 40px 0 40px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(70,103,255,.09),rgba(70,103,255,.02));transform:rotateX(12deg) rotateY(-20deg) rotateZ(-12deg)}.ds-portal-back{transform:translate(-16px,-14px) rotateX(12deg) rotateY(-20deg) rotateZ(-12deg);border-color:#2c407e}.ds-portal-front{box-shadow:0 0 80px rgba(70,103,255,.1);animation:ds-portal-float 7s ease-in-out infinite}.ds-portal-thread{position:absolute;left:10px;right:10px;top:50%;height:1px;background:#3c507e;transform:rotate(-12deg)}.ds-portal-node{position:absolute;right:28px;top:42%;width:8px;height:8px;background:var(--primary,#d4fc68)}@keyframes ds-portal-float{0%,100%{translate:0 0}50%{translate:0 -6px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-portal-front{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
This is a precise, technical identity built from connected planes and deliberate signals. A near-black navy field gives the work depth; electric blue marks actions, while cyan, lime, and violet identify highlights, nodes, and supporting information. Portal frames, fine grids, thin connection paths, and compact mono labels make engineering visible without turning the page into a generic dashboard.

The homepage carries the most dimensional expression through its portal sculpture, blue-violet calls to action, and luminous interface layers. Service pages share the dark palette, Sora and Manrope typography, blue actions, and selectively chamfered shapes, while keeping their own inline layouts. Keep the portal imagery decorative; the words, project scope, and next steps remain readable as HTML.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black navy surfaces with cool, high-contrast text.
Electric-blue actions with white labels; cyan, lime, and violet as signal colors.
Sora display type, Manrope body text, and compact mono labels.
Connected portal planes, fine grids, thin borders, and selective lower-right cuts.
Deliberate motion that can be paused and respects reduced-motion preferences.

rules.name: The Action-Color Rule
rules.body: Electric blue carries primary actions with white labels; cyan, lime, and violet mark emphasis and connection points.

rules.name: The Signal-Type Rule
rules.body: Reserve mono and tracked uppercase for short metadata; keep descriptive copy in Manrope.

rules.name: The Layered-Depth Rule
rules.body: Use tonal contrast, translucent planes, and ambient light to establish depth; reserve stronger shadows for the hero scene and interactive emphasis.

dos: Do preserve the near-black navy base and cool, high-contrast text.
Do assign electric blue to primary actions; use cyan, lime, and violet as signals.
Do use Sora headings, Manrope body text, and compact mono labels.
Do keep portal graphics decorative and put meaningful copy in HTML.
Do retain the motion pause control, visible keyboard focus, and reduced-motion support.
Do use the lower-right cut selectively on portal geometry and related controls.
donts: Don't shift the visual language toward a generic dashboard.
Don't make lime the primary button color; the implementation uses blue action surfaces with white labels.
Don't rely on glow, grids, animation, or imagery to carry essential meaning.
